title: CAVA Deepens Its Midwest Footprint with New Columbus Restaurant
summary: Following its recent Cincinnati opening, CAVA is bringing fresh ingredients and craveable Mediterranean flavors to the capital city, with even more restaurants on the horizon CAVA (NYSE: CAVA), the category-defining Mediterranean fast-casual restaurant brand, opened its doors today at 1370 Polaris Pkwy, Columbus, OH, 43240. CAVA Polaris Pkwy is a 3,660-square-foot restaurant featuring a bright, welcoming dining room, patio seating, seamless digital order pickup, convenient car-friendly pickup options, and delivery designed to meet guests wherever they are in their day. CAVA in Columbus, OH Columbus guests can now experience CAVA’s satisfying, flavor-forward Mediterranean menu, where every meal is as customizable as it is craveable. Guests can enjoy a chef-curated bowl or pita, or build your own from more than 17 billion combinations to match their mood.
